units.rawText: The Oasis' old city, airbase.
units.displayText: The Oasis' old city, airbase.

spans.text: The Oasis' old city, airbase.

units.rawText: Uh... Earhart?
units.displayText: Uh... Earhart?

spans.text: Uh... Earhart?

units.rawText: What's up, Prof?
units.displayText: What's up, Prof?

spans.text: What's up, Prof?

units.rawText: Hearing Earhart's voice from behind me, the trepidation in my heart lurches yet again.
units.displayText: Hearing Earhart's voice from behind me, the trepidation in my heart lurches yet again.

spans.text: Hearing Earhart's voice from behind me, the trepidation in my heart lurches yet again.

units.rawText: Isn't having me fly a plane... a bit too over the top for a date?
units.displayText: Isn't having me fly a plane... a bit too over the top for a date?

spans.text: Isn't having me fly a plane... a bit too over the top for a date?

units.rawText: Don't you worry, Professor! This is the simplest of simple trainer planes!
units.displayText: Don't you worry, Professor! This is the simplest of simple trainer planes!

spans.text: Don't you worry, Professor! This is the simplest of simple trainer planes!

units.rawText: Trainer 6 holds the very accomplished title of "Never-killed-a-soul"! "Don't worry if you stall, this baby knows how to fly better than you ever will!" That's what they all say.
units.displayText: Trainer 6 holds the very accomplished title of "Never-killed-a-soul"! "Don't worry if you stall, this baby knows how to fly better than you ever will!" That's what they all say.

spans.text: Trainer 6 holds the very accomplished title of "Never-killed-a-soul"! "Don't worry if you stall, this baby knows how to fly better than you ever will!" That's what they all say.

units.rawText: Ah, of course, you can't leave it all to the plane's systems, it'll just help you adjust if you stall. Take note that when you take off as well, this one doesn't need to lower the flaps...
units.displayText: Ah, of course, you can't leave it all to the plane's systems, it'll just help you adjust if you stall. Take note that when you take off as well, this one doesn't need to lower the flaps...

spans.text: Ah, of course, you can't leave it all to the plane's systems, it'll just help you adjust if you stall. Take note that when you take off as well, this one doesn't need to lower the flaps...

units.rawText: Earhart explains to me the safety features of the plane without forgetting to go over a checklist of things to do before takeoff.
units.displayText: Earhart explains to me the safety features of the plane without forgetting to go over a checklist of things to do before takeoff.

spans.text: Earhart explains to me the safety features of the plane without forgetting to go over a checklist of things to do before takeoff.

units.rawText: I'll neurally connect with the plane's controls later, and the back seat has controls as well. If something comes up, I can take control, so don't be afraid to get flashy!
units.displayText: I'll neurally connect with the plane's controls later, and the back seat has controls as well. If something comes up, I can take control, so don't be afraid to get flashy!

spans.text: I'll neurally connect with the plane's controls later, and the back seat has controls as well. If something comes up, I can take control, so don't be afraid to get flashy!

units.rawText: Even if you say that, I'm a beginner. Going hands-on from the very start is...
units.displayText: Even if you say that, I'm a beginner. Going hands-on from the very start is...

spans.text: Even if you say that, I'm a beginner. Going hands-on from the very start is...

units.rawText: It makes you just tremble in excitement, right? Makes your neural systems run at twice the speed.
units.displayText: It makes you just tremble in excitement, right? Makes your neural systems run at twice the speed.

spans.text: It makes you just tremble in excitement, right? Makes your neural systems run at twice the speed.

units.rawText: Twice the speed indeed...
units.displayText: Twice the speed indeed...

spans.text: Twice the speed indeed...

units.rawText: Hahaha, stop worrying! Just listen to my instructions, and you'll be having a grand old time zooming towards the sky.
units.displayText: Hahaha, stop worrying! Just listen to my instructions, and you'll be having a grand old time zooming towards the sky.

spans.text: Hahaha, stop worrying! Just listen to my instructions, and you'll be having a grand old time zooming towards the sky.

units.rawText: Ok, I got it.
units.displayText: Ok, I got it.

spans.text: Ok, I got it.

units.rawText: I take a deep breath, trying to internalize Earhart's teachings from before.
units.displayText: I take a deep breath, trying to internalize Earhart's teachings from before.

spans.text: I take a deep breath, trying to internalize Earhart's teachings from before.

units.rawText: Throttle, lever, final checks... Here we go...
units.displayText: Throttle, lever, final checks... Here we go...

spans.text: Throttle, lever, final checks... Here we go...

units.rawText: Still fidgety, I begin to gradually accelerate. The scenery nearby gradually grows blurry as we approach takeoff speed.
units.displayText: Still fidgety, I begin to gradually accelerate. The scenery nearby gradually grows blurry as we approach takeoff speed.

spans.text: Still fidgety, I begin to gradually accelerate. The scenery nearby gradually grows blurry as we approach takeoff speed.

units.rawText: <size=40>Now!</size>
units.displayText: Now!

spans.text: Now!

units.rawText: As the engine roars, this beast of metal takes to the air under its own power.
units.displayText: As the engine roars, this beast of metal takes to the air under its own power.

spans.text: As the engine roars, this beast of metal takes to the air under its own power.

units.rawText: Landing gear, check. Altitude, check. Orientation, check...
units.displayText: Landing gear, check. Altitude, check. Orientation, check...

spans.text: Landing gear, check. Altitude, check. Orientation, check...

units.rawText: Well done! Professor, how does it feel to take off for the first time?
units.displayText: Well done! Professor, how does it feel to take off for the first time?

spans.text: Well done! Professor, how does it feel to take off for the first time?

options.rawText: I could see myself becoming an ace pilot.
options.displayText: I could see myself becoming an ace pilot.

spans.text: I could see myself becoming an ace pilot.

options.rawText: Not quite as comfortable as when I ride in the back of your plane, Earhart.
options.displayText: Not quite as comfortable as when I ride in the back of your plane, Earhart.

spans.text: Not quite as comfortable as when I ride in the back of your plane, Earhart.

units.rawText: If it's you, Professor, I could very well see it. Being audacious while still paying attention to the details is an important skill for a pilot.
units.displayText: If it's you, Professor, I could very well see it. Being audacious while still paying attention to the details is an important skill for a pilot.

spans.text: If it's you, Professor, I could very well see it. Being audacious while still paying attention to the details is an important skill for a pilot.

units.rawText: Hahaha, the trainers are not built for comfort or power, after all. It gets off the ground, it's easy to handle, and it's safe. That's what matters.
units.displayText: Hahaha, the trainers are not built for comfort or power, after all. It gets off the ground, it's easy to handle, and it's safe. That's what matters.

spans.text: Hahaha, the trainers are not built for comfort or power, after all. It gets off the ground, it's easy to handle, and it's safe. That's what matters.

units.rawText: For your first actual takeover, you've done a bang up job, Professor. Let me handle the rest.
units.displayText: For your first actual takeover, you've done a bang up job, Professor. Let me handle the rest.

spans.text: For your first actual takeover, you've done a bang up job, Professor. Let me handle the rest.

units.rawText: Earhart takes over control of the airplane as protocol would dictate, freeing me from the stress of being at the reins.
units.displayText: Earhart takes over control of the airplane as protocol would dictate, freeing me from the stress of being at the reins.

spans.text: Earhart takes over control of the airplane as protocol would dictate, freeing me from the stress of being at the reins.

units.rawText: Let me get more experience in a simulator first next time.
units.displayText: Let me get more experience in a simulator first next time.

spans.text: Let me get more experience in a simulator first next time.

units.rawText: As I begin to let out a sigh of relief, a orange silhouette darts into my lap from the back of the cabin, looking about curiously.
units.displayText: As I begin to let out a sigh of relief, a orange silhouette darts into my lap from the back of the cabin, looking about curiously.

spans.text: As I begin to let out a sigh of relief, a orange silhouette darts into my lap from the back of the cabin, looking about curiously.

units.rawText: Oi, don't run around in the cabin! And don't get in the Professor's way!
units.displayText: Oi, don't run around in the cabin! And don't get in the Professor's way!

spans.text: Oi, don't run around in the cabin! And don't get in the Professor's way!

units.rawText: The fox raises its head, throwing a look at Earhart in the back seat. It returns to its previous position in my lap, enjoying the view from this altitude.
units.displayText: The fox raises its head, throwing a look at Earhart in the back seat. It returns to its previous position in my lap, enjoying the view from this altitude.

spans.text: The fox raises its head, throwing a look at Earhart in the back seat. It returns to its previous position in my lap, enjoying the view from this altitude.

units.rawText: Was that contempt in its eyes I saw?! Hey, I'm the owner here!
units.displayText: Was that contempt in its eyes I saw?! Hey, I'm the owner here!

spans.text: Was that contempt in its eyes I saw?! Hey, I'm the owner here!

units.rawText: Seriously, when we get back to reality, I have some questions for the designer. There's gotta be something wrong with that little thing's systems...
units.displayText: Seriously, when we get back to reality, I have some questions for the designer. There's gotta be something wrong with that little thing's systems...

spans.text: Seriously, when we get back to reality, I have some questions for the designer. There's gotta be something wrong with that little thing's systems...

units.rawText: I think you'll have to ask the designers whether or not they installed a Kung Fu Fox module in it.
units.displayText: I think you'll have to ask the designers whether or not they installed a Kung Fu Fox module in it.

spans.text: I think you'll have to ask the designers whether or not they installed a Kung Fu Fox module in it.

units.rawText: Neptune's Onslaught's going to have some of that nine-tails chakra soon.
units.displayText: Neptune's Onslaught's going to have some of that nine-tails chakra soon.

spans.text: Neptune's Onslaught's going to have some of that nine-tails chakra soon.

units.rawText: Hahaha, it's not just you, Professor. I got put through the ringer at first with the little guy too. It's very wary of strangers.
units.displayText: Hahaha, it's not just you, Professor. I got put through the ringer at first with the little guy too. It's very wary of strangers.

spans.text: Hahaha, it's not just you, Professor. I got put through the ringer at first with the little guy too. It's very wary of strangers.

units.rawText: It's not even a real fox, but I had to go through the whole domestication song and dance with it anyway. An absolute pain, if you ask me.
units.displayText: It's not even a real fox, but I had to go through the whole domestication song and dance with it anyway. An absolute pain, if you ask me.

spans.text: It's not even a real fox, but I had to go through the whole domestication song and dance with it anyway. An absolute pain, if you ask me.

units.rawText: And the designer even told me that training it was a necessary process... sigh...
units.displayText: And the designer even told me that training it was a necessary process... sigh...

spans.text: And the designer even told me that training it was a necessary process... sigh...

units.rawText: I think it's pretty cute this way. Makes me think of how you used to be, Earhart.
units.displayText: I think it's pretty cute this way. Makes me think of how you used to be, Earhart.

spans.text: I think it's pretty cute this way. Makes me think of how you used to be, Earhart.

units.rawText: As if. I wasn't nearly as destructive as that little guy.
units.displayText: As if. I wasn't nearly as destructive as that little guy.

spans.text: As if. I wasn't nearly as destructive as that little guy.

units.rawText: You always kept your distance from me at first, too. Not quite the same in action, but certainly just as suspicious.
units.displayText: You always kept your distance from me at first, too. Not quite the same in action, but certainly just as suspicious.

spans.text: You always kept your distance from me at first, too. Not quite the same in action, but certainly just as suspicious.

units.rawText: ...That's true. I didn't really understand you back then. In my mind, you were still a weak and sickly researcher type of figure.
units.displayText: ...That's true. I didn't really understand you back then. In my mind, you were still a weak and sickly researcher type of figure.

spans.text: ...That's true. I didn't really understand you back then. In my mind, you were still a weak and sickly researcher type of figure.

units.rawText: Thankfully, you never gave up on getting through to me, Professor. Would've been terrible if you did.
units.displayText: Thankfully, you never gave up on getting through to me, Professor. Would've been terrible if you did.

spans.text: Thankfully, you never gave up on getting through to me, Professor. Would've been terrible if you did.

units.rawText: Now that we're talking about it, though... am I like a fox to you, Professor?
units.displayText: Now that we're talking about it, though... am I like a fox to you, Professor?

spans.text: Now that we're talking about it, though... am I like a fox to you, Professor?

units.rawText: If we go by that fairy tale, rather than a fox, you would be a rose. One without compare.
units.displayText: If we go by that fairy tale, rather than a fox, you would be a rose. One without compare.

spans.text: If we go by that fairy tale, rather than a fox, you would be a rose. One without compare.

units.rawText: ...Professor, you really just go around saying such things with a straight face.
units.displayText: ...Professor, you really just go around saying such things with a straight face.

spans.text: ...Professor, you really just go around saying such things with a straight face.

units.rawText: What, Earhart, are you embarrassed?
units.displayText: What, Earhart, are you embarrassed?

spans.text: What, Earhart, are you embarrassed?

units.rawText: Eeh... Professor!
units.displayText: Eeh... Professor!

spans.text: Eeh... Professor!

units.rawText: Even without being able to see her face from the front seat, I can imagine her reddened face in the back of the cabin.
units.displayText: Even without being able to see her face from the front seat, I can imagine her reddened face in the back of the cabin.

spans.text: Even without being able to see her face from the front seat, I can imagine her reddened face in the back of the cabin.

units.rawText: Professor, you're laughing at me, aren't you?
units.displayText: Professor, you're laughing at me, aren't you?

spans.text: Professor, you're laughing at me, aren't you?

units.rawText: No, not at all, the fox can vouch for... woah!
units.displayText: No, not at all, the fox can vouch for... woah!

spans.text: No, not at all, the fox can vouch for... woah!

units.rawText: Before I can finish my sentence, a sudden great acceleration hits me along with the intense feeling of weightlessness.
units.displayText: Before I can finish my sentence, a sudden great acceleration hits me along with the intense feeling of weightlessness.

spans.text: Before I can finish my sentence, a sudden great acceleration hits me along with the intense feeling of weightlessness.

units.rawText: The originally level plane suddenly dives towards the ground before immediately pulling upwards again.
units.displayText: The originally level plane suddenly dives towards the ground before immediately pulling upwards again.

spans.text: The originally level plane suddenly dives towards the ground before immediately pulling upwards again.

units.rawText: E... Earhart?
units.displayText: E... Earhart?

spans.text: E... Earhart?

units.rawText: Hehe~ This is the "reward" you get for teasing me, Professor. Before we land, let's make good use of what time we have.
units.displayText: Hehe~ This is the "reward" you get for teasing me, Professor. Before we land, let's make good use of what time we have.

spans.text: Hehe~ This is the "reward" you get for teasing me, Professor. Before we land, let's make good use of what time we have.

units.rawText: W-Wait a second... safety first! Safety first!
units.displayText: W-Wait a second... safety first! Safety first!

spans.text: W-Wait a second... safety first! Safety first!

units.rawText: Subject to Earhart's whims, I begin to spin in the air along with the cabin like a piece of clothing in a tumble dryer.
units.displayText: Subject to Earhart's whims, I begin to spin in the air along with the cabin like a piece of clothing in a tumble dryer.

spans.text: Subject to Earhart's whims, I begin to spin in the air along with the cabin like a piece of clothing in a tumble dryer.

units.rawText: <size=40>!!!</size>
Safety first, Earhart!
units.displayText: Safety first, Earhart!

spans.text: Safety first, Earhart!

units.rawText: Hahahaha—woohoo! Sorry, Professor, what were you saying?
units.displayText: Hahahaha—woohoo! Sorry, Professor, what were you saying?

spans.text: Hahahaha—woohoo! Sorry, Professor, what were you saying?

units.rawText: <size=40>I said—safety—first—</size>
units.displayText: I said—safety—first—

spans.text: I said—safety—first—

units.rawText: In her skillful hands, the plane executes a series of stunts in the air, soaring through the air as freely as a real bird of prey.
units.displayText: In her skillful hands, the plane executes a series of stunts in the air, soaring through the air as freely as a real bird of prey.

spans.text: In her skillful hands, the plane executes a series of stunts in the air, soaring through the air as freely as a real bird of prey.

units.rawText: I can only brace inside the cabin as I offer prayers that this plane really is as Earhart says, safe and easy to handle.
units.displayText: I can only brace inside the cabin as I offer prayers that this plane really is as Earhart says, safe and easy to handle.

spans.text: I can only brace inside the cabin as I offer prayers that this plane really is as Earhart says, safe and easy to handle.

units.rawText: The Oasis, the pinnacle.
units.displayText: The Oasis, the pinnacle.

spans.text: The Oasis, the pinnacle.

units.rawText: I think I understand now why people say the Earth is like a mother...
units.displayText: I think I understand now why people say the Earth is like a mother...

spans.text: I think I understand now why people say the Earth is like a mother...

units.rawText: After experiencing twenty-odd stunts in the air, we land safely. At Earhart's very insistent behest, she brought me to the Oasis's highest point.
units.displayText: After experiencing twenty-odd stunts in the air, we land safely. At Earhart's very insistent behest, she brought me to the Oasis's highest point.

spans.text: After experiencing twenty-odd stunts in the air, we land safely. At Earhart's very insistent behest, she brought me to the Oasis's highest point.

units.rawText: I lightly rub my temples, trying to allay the disorientation from the g-forces.
units.displayText: I lightly rub my temples, trying to allay the disorientation from the g-forces.

spans.text: I lightly rub my temples, trying to allay the disorientation from the g-forces.

units.rawText: I should have the medical department prescribe me some motion sickness medicine next time...
units.displayText: I should have the medical department prescribe me some motion sickness medicine next time...

spans.text: I should have the medical department prescribe me some motion sickness medicine next time...

units.rawText: Never thought that this was our destination... where's Earhart?
units.displayText: Never thought that this was our destination... where's Earhart?

spans.text: Never thought that this was our destination... where's Earhart?

units.rawText: This is the place with the nicest view in the entirety of the Oasis~ One of my favorite places on the ground.
units.displayText: This is the place with the nicest view in the entirety of the Oasis~ One of my favorite places on the ground.

spans.text: This is the place with the nicest view in the entirety of the Oasis~ One of my favorite places on the ground.

units.rawText: Rather than get medication, you should do more high-g training with me, Professor.
units.displayText: Rather than get medication, you should do more high-g training with me, Professor.

spans.text: Rather than get medication, you should do more high-g training with me, Professor.

units.rawText: Oh, you're back... huh?
units.displayText: Oh, you're back... huh?

spans.text: Oh, you're back... huh?

units.rawText: I turn around subconsciously. A girl completely different from how she usually is comes into my view.
units.displayText: I turn around subconsciously. A girl completely different from how she usually is comes into my view.

spans.text: I turn around subconsciously. A girl completely different from how she usually is comes into my view.

units.rawText: A shade of red upon her face and flowers in her hands, Earhart stands before me. Her usual flight suit is absent, its place taken by a dress of purest white.
units.displayText: A shade of red upon her face and flowers in her hands, Earhart stands before me. Her usual flight suit is absent, its place taken by a dress of purest white.

spans.text: A shade of red upon her face and flowers in her hands, Earhart stands before me. Her usual flight suit is absent, its place taken by a dress of purest white.

units.rawText: What do you think, Professor?
units.displayText: What do you think, Professor?

spans.text: What do you think, Professor?
It's gorgeous.

options.rawText: It's not often I see you outside of your flight suit.
options.displayText: It's not often I see you outside of your flight suit.

spans.text: It's not often I see you outside of your flight suit.

units.rawText: Pfft... your expression is something else, Professor. Looks like my surprise worked out.
units.displayText: Pfft... your expression is something else, Professor. Looks like my surprise worked out.

spans.text: Pfft... your expression is something else, Professor. Looks like my surprise worked out.

units.rawText: This dress, you...
units.displayText: This dress, you...

spans.text: This dress, you...

units.rawText: I prepared it for you, of course. I would never wear anything this puffy usually, I'd struggle to even get into a cabin.
units.displayText: I prepared it for you, of course. I would never wear anything this puffy usually, I'd struggle to even get into a cabin.

spans.text: I prepared it for you, of course. I would never wear anything this puffy usually, I'd struggle to even get into a cabin.

units.rawText: She lifts the hems of her dress, elegantly spinning in place.
units.displayText: She lifts the hems of her dress, elegantly spinning in place.

spans.text: She lifts the hems of her dress, elegantly spinning in place.

units.rawText: Though sometimes, it's good to switch it up. Especially if I get to see you make an expression like that, Professor.
units.displayText: Though sometimes, it's good to switch it up. Especially if I get to see you make an expression like that, Professor.

spans.text: Though sometimes, it's good to switch it up. Especially if I get to see you make an expression like that, Professor.

units.rawText: And what motivated you to switch it up?
units.displayText: And what motivated you to switch it up?

spans.text: And what motivated you to switch it up?

units.rawText: Professor, I can see you holding that smile back! Don't ask if you already know, jeez!
units.displayText: Professor, I can see you holding that smile back! Don't ask if you already know, jeez!

spans.text: Professor, I can see you holding that smile back! Don't ask if you already know, jeez!

units.rawText: With a blush on her face, Earhart pouts, discontent.
units.displayText: With a blush on her face, Earhart pouts, discontent.

spans.text: With a blush on her face, Earhart pouts, discontent.

units.rawText: I'm dressed like this, because I have something so very important to tell you, Professor...
units.displayText: I'm dressed like this, because I have something so very important to tell you, Professor...

spans.text: I'm dressed like this, because I have something so very important to tell you, Professor...

units.rawText: Her voice grows somewhat fainter. She tidies up her dress, adjusts her stance, and looks at me earnestly.
units.displayText: Her voice grows somewhat fainter. She tidies up her dress, adjusts her stance, and looks at me earnestly.

spans.text: Her voice grows somewhat fainter. She tidies up her dress, adjusts her stance, and looks at me earnestly.

units.rawText: We started as complete strangers, but as we spent more and more time together, we've very well become inseparable.
units.displayText: We started as complete strangers, but as we spent more and more time together, we've very well become inseparable.

spans.text: We started as complete strangers, but as we spent more and more time together, we've very well become inseparable.

units.rawText: When I was powerless and alone, you stood by my side. When I had to carry out my duty, you were the first to understand.
units.displayText: When I was powerless and alone, you stood by my side. When I had to carry out my duty, you were the first to understand.

spans.text: When I was powerless and alone, you stood by my side. When I had to carry out my duty, you were the first to understand.

units.rawText: And most important of all... I really, really like being with you, Professor!
units.displayText: And most important of all... I really, really like being with you, Professor!

spans.text: And most important of all... I really, really like being with you, Professor!

units.rawText: Earhart...
units.displayText: Earhart...

spans.text: Earhart...

units.rawText: In truth, I hated Magrasea's skies at first. No layers of clouds, no slipstreams. Flying was nothing more than pushing into... a gray sky, powered by operands.
units.displayText: In truth, I hated Magrasea's skies at first. No layers of clouds, no slipstreams. Flying was nothing more than pushing into... a gray sky, powered by operands.

spans.text: In truth, I hated Magrasea's skies at first. No layers of clouds, no slipstreams. Flying was nothing more than pushing into... a gray sky, powered by operands.

units.rawText: But if I'm with you, Professor, even the Null Zones' skies take on a different color.
units.displayText: But if I'm with you, Professor, even the Null Zones' skies take on a different color.

spans.text: But if I'm with you, Professor, even the Null Zones' skies take on a different color.

units.rawText: She takes a deep breath, approaching me and handing me the flowers in her arms.
units.displayText: She takes a deep breath, approaching me and handing me the flowers in her arms.

spans.text: She takes a deep breath, approaching me and handing me the flowers in her arms.

units.rawText: You said just then, Professor, up there... you said I was a rose, one without compare.
units.displayText: You said just then, Professor, up there... you said I was a rose, one without compare.

spans.text: You said just then, Professor, up there... you said I was a rose, one without compare.

units.rawText: And to me, Professor... you are my prince, one without equal.
units.displayText: And to me, Professor... you are my prince, one without equal.

spans.text: And to me, Professor... you are my prince, one without equal.

units.rawText: So, Professor... I want our relationship to be even more intimate...
units.displayText: So, Professor... I want our relationship to be even more intimate...

spans.text: So, Professor... I want our relationship to be even more intimate...

units.rawText: Professor, will you swear an oath with me?
units.displayText: Professor, will you swear an oath with me?

spans.text: Professor, will you swear an oath with me?

units.rawText: Earhart's face is thoroughly flushed. Even with some distance between us, I can clearly hear her nervous breathing.
units.displayText: Earhart's face is thoroughly flushed. Even with some distance between us, I can clearly hear her nervous breathing.

spans.text: Earhart's face is thoroughly flushed. Even with some distance between us, I can clearly hear her nervous breathing.

units.rawText: She awaits my answer as I make up my mind.
units.displayText: She awaits my answer as I make up my mind.

spans.text: She awaits my answer as I make up my mind.
I will.

units.rawText: I produce a very special token for Earhart.
units.displayText: I produce a very special token for Earhart.

spans.text: I produce a very special token for Earhart.

units.rawText: I really like being with you as well, Earhart.
units.displayText: I really like being with you as well, Earhart.

spans.text: I really like being with you as well, Earhart.

units.rawText: Whenever I look towards the sky, my mind wanders to you, and what I would see if I were up in the sky with you.
units.displayText: Whenever I look towards the sky, my mind wanders to you, and what I would see if I were up in the sky with you.

spans.text: Whenever I look towards the sky, my mind wanders to you, and what I would see if I were up in the sky with you.

units.rawText: Professor...
units.displayText: Professor...

spans.text: Professor...

units.rawText: I intended to tell you how I felt today. I never imagined that you would beat me to it.
units.displayText: I intended to tell you how I felt today. I never imagined that you would beat me to it.

spans.text: I intended to tell you how I felt today. I never imagined that you would beat me to it.

units.rawText: I take her hand in mine, placing the oath certificate I had prepared long ago on her finger.
units.displayText: I take her hand in mine, placing the oath certificate I had prepared long ago on her finger.

spans.text: I take her hand in mine, placing the oath certificate I had prepared long ago on her finger.

units.rawText: Hehehe... is that the certificate?
units.displayText: Hehehe... is that the certificate?

spans.text: Hehehe... is that the certificate?

units.rawText: I'm not dreaming, right? Professor can we... can we fly around for a bit again, just to make sure?
units.displayText: I'm not dreaming, right? Professor can we... can we fly around for a bit again, just to make sure?

spans.text: I'm not dreaming, right? Professor can we... can we fly around for a bit again, just to make sure?

units.rawText: What kind of ridiculous method is that? Here, let me pinch your face.
units.displayText: What kind of ridiculous method is that? Here, let me pinch your face.

spans.text: What kind of ridiculous method is that? Here, let me pinch your face.

units.rawText: Eh?! Owie! Hehehe, it's all real!
units.displayText: Eh?! Owie! Hehehe, it's all real!

spans.text: Eh?! Owie! Hehehe, it's all real!

units.rawText: Since it is... then let's go and celebrate using a different plane, alright? I'd recommend the AN-2 freighter~
units.displayText: Since it is... then let's go and celebrate using a different plane, alright? I'd recommend the AN-2 freighter~

spans.text: Since it is... then let's go and celebrate using a different plane, alright? I'd recommend the AN-2 freighter~

units.rawText: That's not something you're going to do weird stunts in, right?
units.displayText: That's not something you're going to do weird stunts in, right?

spans.text: That's not something you're going to do weird stunts in, right?

units.rawText: Don't you worry, this one's as safe as it gets! If it really comes down to it, you can just pull up on the lever and fly it like a glider.
units.displayText: Don't you worry, this one's as safe as it gets! If it really comes down to it, you can just pull up on the lever and fly it like a glider.

spans.text: Don't you worry, this one's as safe as it gets! If it really comes down to it, you can just pull up on the lever and fly it like a glider.

units.rawText: Most importantly—I can pilot it alongside you, Professor.
units.displayText: Most importantly—I can pilot it alongside you, Professor.

spans.text: Most importantly—I can pilot it alongside you, Professor.

units.rawText: Promise me you'll be safe.
units.displayText: Promise me you'll be safe.

spans.text: Promise me you'll be safe.

units.rawText: Ah, right, we can try the Italian Taliedo Stipa afterwards, too... it's super round, and super cute!
units.displayText: Ah, right, we can try the Italian Taliedo Stipa afterwards, too... it's super round, and super cute!

spans.text: Ah, right, we can try the Italian Taliedo Stipa afterwards, too... it's super round, and super cute!

units.rawText: Taking me by the hand, Earhart makes for the skies with me enthusiastically.
units.displayText: Taking me by the hand, Earhart makes for the skies with me enthusiastically.

spans.text: Taking me by the hand, Earhart makes for the skies with me enthusiastically.

units.rawText: It would be as she expected. We had countless adventures in the blue skies awaiting us in the future. Together.
